specimen.name: adhesive.dll
specimen.note: read as a byte slice through the section table; never mapped or run

families.data_record: a pdata range with zero control-flow terminators whose own bytes classify as data; the record is a table registered as a code range
families.undecoded_range: undecoded_bytes > 0; the function is re-decoded with cfg_build.FunctionBuilder and one region is emitted per maximal byte run its coverage map leaves uncovered. A function above the re-decode cap contributes one whole-range region instead, and is counted in counters.oversize_undecoded_functions
families.switch_unvalidated: switch_sites_rejected > 0; reason carries the highest ranked entry of method.switch_reject_severity present in switch_reject_reasons, so a plausible table with broken targets outranks a table the builder could not bound
families.multi_entry: entry_external_calls + entry_external_jumps + (entry_internal > 0) > 1, or overlap_role != sole, or overlap_partners > 0
families.pdata_gap: every run of section bytes between consecutive IMAGE_RUNTIME_FUNCTION ranges plus the region before the first and after the last record

kind_rules: 1. data    terminators == 0 and dword_rva_ratio >= 0.45 and linear_ratio < 0.85
2. data    terminators == 0 and small_byte_ratio >= 0.6 and linear_ratio < 0.85
5. unknown everything else, including pure inter-function alignment padding
ok_rules: true  benign_padding: the bytes are inter-function alignment padding and nothing else
true  data_record: the pdata range is proven to be a table, so its code coverage question is answered even though the metadata is wrong
true  multi_entry with kind code or data: a pure entry-point count, nothing left to decode
false every other family, and every region whose kind stayed unknown
confidence_rules: 1. HIGH   data_record, undecoded_range, switch_unvalidated, boundary_cross and multi_entry: the verdict is a counted field of the cfg builder, an exact re-decode, or a byte rule confirmed by independent signals
2. HIGH   pdata_gap whose core is empty, or whose dword_rva_ratio >= 0.9 with linear_ratio < 0.85
3. MEDIUM pdata_gap whose core is attributed to code, or that stays unknown after a partial linear sweep
4. MEDIUM linear_only_blocks: aggregate counters only, sub ranges not re-decoded
5. LOW    owner larger than the re-decode cap, owner bytes not fully file backed, or a non-gap region whose kind stayed unknown

priority_sources.security: the owner imports one of the curated KERNEL32, CRYPT32, WS2_32, ADVAPI32, CFGMGR32, IPHLPAPI or ole32 symbols, or carries a security doc_anchor
priority_sources.syscall: the owner has syscall_sites > 0 or a direct_syscall_site anchor
priority_sources.patch: the owner carries a patcher_entry anchor, or its pdata range contains an RVA the patch audit already attributes
priority_sources.lifecycle: the owner imports a module load, TLS, init-once, exception-filter, fiber or event-source symbol, or its pdata range contains the PE entry point, an export or a TLS callback

method.row_order: priority tag rank, then family rank, then begin_rva, then end_rva, then reason; region_id is the 1-based ordinal of that order

determinism.unordered_iteration: every set is sorted before it reaches the payload

limitations: cfg_functions.csv caps iat_symbols at 8 entries per function, so priority attribution can miss a security import on the 22 capped rows, 20 of which are flagged here

linear_ratio covers the contiguous prefix a straight sweep decodes; a region stops the sweep at its first undecodable byte and the remainder is reported through first_fail_rva_hex rather than per instruction
kind is a byte level heuristic, not a semantic proof; a range that fits neither rule is reported as unknown rather than guessed
priority tags for a pdata_gap come from both bordering records, because a hole belongs to neither

regions_scope.note: the csv is the complete region table; the json embeds every non-gap family and the first pdata_gap_regions_in_json gaps in row order

column_notes.confidence: HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW, first match of method.confidence_rules
column_notes.content: body shape: int3_pad, zero_pad, nop_pad, mixed_pad, body
column_notes.doc_anchor: documented anchors of the owner, as recorded by cfg_build
column_notes.dword_rva_ratio: share of 4-byte words of the non-pad core that point inside the image, either as a pre-relocation RVA or as a VA
column_notes.evidence: semicolon separated key=value facts that have no dedicated column: the block terminator and instruction site histograms, the entry-point and overlap inputs, the full switch reject reason set, and the owner attribution used for priority
column_notes.first_fail_rva_hex: where the linear sweep stopped inside the core, empty if it did not
column_notes.fn: bordering pdata record as <record_index>:<begin_hex>-<end_hex>, the owner
column_notes.fn_next: for a pdata_gap the record that follows the gap, same encoding as fn
column_notes.kind: code | data | unknown, first match of method.kind_rules
column_notes.linear_decoded_bytes: bytes the linear sweep consumed before it stopped
column_notes.linear_ratio: share of the non-pad core a straight linear sweep decoded contiguously
column_notes.ok: true when the audit fully accounted for the region, false when a residual is left
column_notes.prefix_pad_bytes: leading core bytes that are alignment padding only
column_notes.region_id: UR-000001 style ordinal, assigned after the fixed sort, 1-based
column_notes.small_byte_ratio: share of non-pad core bytes below 0x10
column_notes.suffix_pad_bytes: trailing core bytes that are alignment padding only

checks.expected: one data_record region per pinned begin
